senses.definition: (Internet slang, sometimes derogatory) An extremely obsessive fan of a person, group, character, or creative work, particularly one whose fixation is unhealthy or intrusive.

quotes.text: I know the in-depth detailed life of a stan because I am one. I'm one of those Lady Gaga fans, […]
quotes.reference: 2011 October 11, Vanessa Spates, “Whether in Britney's Army or Rihanna's Navy, stans need to surrender to sanity”, in The Lantern, volume 132, number 16, Ohio State University, page 9A:

quotes.text: I am the biggest stan for Selena because she is my queen. She made Disney interesting and I have always watched her.
quotes.reference: 2013 March 17, “Selena Gomez: She Is My Queen”, in Sunday Tribune, South Africa:

quotes.text: Incidents have occurred with stans showing up to pop stars' residences, as has happened with Madonna, Taylor Swift and others.
quotes.reference: 2013 December 5, Jake Folsom, “Stans take dedication to extreme heights online, in real life”, in Washington Square News, volume 41, number 104, page 11:

quotes.text: K-pop stans have been getting increasingly involved in American politics in recent months. After the Trump campaign solicited messages for the president’s birthday on June 8, K-pop stans submitted a stream of prank messages.
quotes.reference: 2020 June 21, “TikTok Teens and K-Pop Stans Say They Sank Trump Rally”, in The New York Times:

quotes.text: “Stans will literally go to any extent to defend anyone,” he said of Mr. Depp’s supporters, adding: “Amber Heard, she has not got that fan base.”
quotes.reference: 2022 April 29, Ezra Marcus, “Johnny Depp Case Brings Stan Culture Into the Courtroom”, in The New York Times, →ISSN:

senses.definition: (slang, transitive, intransitive) To act as a stan (for); to be an obsessive fan (of).
examples: For quotations using this term, see Citations:stan.

senses.definition: (informal) A country, often ex-Soviet, whose name ends with -stan, such as Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan, or Kazakhstan.

quotes.text:
“There are a lot of former Soviet states – a lot of stans.”
This is a stan with a plan. Unlike Uzbekistan[…].
